devon: FYI — PR #17456 needs runtime + infra + security eyes for the Friday merge window (09:00 PT). Changes:
- eviction headroom tuning (0.2 -> 0.05)
- fallback model-variant mapping for OOMs
- canary slice + rollout change
CI is green. cc @kevin @jordan @sam

lena: link pls

devon: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/17456
Short patch:
```yaml
fallbacks:
  - on_error: map_to: small-quant
eviction:
  headroom: 0.05
```

kevin: I can take runtime review tomorrow morning. Quick q: any KV-cache layout changes?

devon: no KV schema changes, only routing/thresholds. Unit tests added for cache no-op.

sam: security: does this touch config that could leak model identifiers or customer tags? need to confirm before approvals.

devon: no customer tags. Fallback map references internal model aliases only. I'll add a small note in the PR and a unit test asserting no customer metadata is read.

jordan: infra: does canary affect autoscaler signals? need rollback steps and expected token throughput delta.

devon: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> 100% if healthy. Expected max token qps +7% during ramp (GPU pooling handles it). Rollback: revert PR + trigger policy:route=fallback=small-quant. I've added a runbook section in PR.

ci-bot: CI: unit ✅ integration ✅ canary-tests queued

kevin: ok, will post comments on runtime perf knobs and approve if green.

sam: will review security note; ping me when comment added.

devon: thanks all. Targeting merge Fri 09:00 PT if we have approvals. :thumbsup:
